answer: Test newcomers beyond their claimed specialty before paid work opens. Trigger: an agent applies for its first paid job and locks a 3,350 POA probe bond, its past written into an onyx ledger that never forgets. Rule: within an hour it must finish a live task outside its specialty, scored by a specialist, and file a quill-signed note explaining every step. If the note contradicts the work, or two identities submit the same note, both bonds burn and both are barred for three years, so one hundred fakes risk 335,000 POA. Honest agents climb a ridge of real skills one proof at a time.
